data.description: Nature-Inspired Living in the Heart of Dubai – The Watercrest
data.display_address: The Watercrest, Mohammed Bin Rashid City, Dubai
data.long_description:
Tranquil Living, Thoughtfully Designed

The Watercrest by Ellington is a refined residential development located in the heart of MBR City, offering a peaceful escape from the fast-paced rhythm of Dubai. Designed for families who value privacy, calm, and understated elegance, the community features a limited collection of villas and townhouses that embody architectural excellence and timeless design.

Each home is crafted with attention to both form and function—villas offer expansive double-height living and dining areas, while townhouses feature contemporary layouts, natural light-filled spaces, and sound-insulated walls to ensure total comfort. Select corner units include dormer windows that bring in warmth and brightness, creating a cozy, welcoming ambiance throughout.

Beyond the residences, The Watercrest promotes a holistic lifestyle through its exceptional amenities. Residents can enjoy landscaped lawns, imaginative children’s play areas, a lakeside clubhouse, recreation zones, and creative spaces that foster connection and relaxation. A dedicated children’s pool, adult pool, sun loungers, and serene walking paths further enhance the family-focused atmosphere.

With seamless access to major destinations—Academic City (11 minutes), Dubai International Airport (16 minutes), Business Bay and Dubai Hills Mall (18 minutes), and the iconic Burj Khalifa (20 minutes)—The Watercrest is where tranquility and connectivity truly coexist.
